card.title: Derivation of Pressure Exerted by Gas

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: The kinetic-theory pressure derivation proceeds in six steps: one wall collision reverses momentum $mu \to -mu$ (transfer $2mu$); the round trip takes $2l/u$; one molecule delivers momentum at rate $mu^2/l$; summing over N molecules gives force $m\sum u_i^2/l$; dividing by the wall area $l^2$ gives $P = Nm\bar{u^2}/V$; and isotropy ($\bar{u^2} = \bar{c^2}/3$) yields the boxed result $P = \frac{1}{3}\rho\bar{c^2}$.…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: - P = Nm c̄²/3V = ⅓ρc̄² - ½m c̄² = (3/2)k_BT - v_rms = √(3P/ρ) = √(3RT/M)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **The ⅓ comes from three dimensions:** u² = v² = w² = c̄²/3 on average.  ·  **Round trip 2l, not l:** the molecule must return before hitting the same wall again.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **Numerical (3m): Find the rms speed of hydrogen molecules (M = 2 g/mol) at 300 K.** — v_rms = √(3×8.31×300/0.002) = √(3.74×10⁶) = 1934 m/s ≈ 1.9 km/s — why hydrogen escapes Earth's upper atmosphere.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **Momentum per collision = 2mu; time per round trip = 2l/u** — the two numbers that build the derivation.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: P = ⅓ρc̄² = Nm c̄²/3V.  ·  Matching with PV = NkT gives KE = (3/2)k_BT.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Oxygen's rms speed at room temperature is ~480 m/s — yet diffusion seems slow because of countless collisions.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — From Collisions to Pressure The kinetic theory's centrepiece is a calculation: track one molecule bouncing between walls, count its momentum transfers, multiply by N molecules, and the gas pressure appears as $\frac{1}{3}\rho \bar{c^2}$. Matching this to PV = NkT then makes temperature a molecular quantity.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts ### 2.1 Derivation of $P = \frac{1}{3}\rho \bar{c^2}$ Consider a cubic box of side $l$ containing $N$ molecules, each of mass $m$, with the x-component of a typical molecule's velocity $u$. 1. **One collision with the wall** perpendicular to x reverses $u$: momentum change $= mu - (-mu) = 2mu$. 2.…  ·  **The four steps of the derivation** | Step | Statement | Result | |---|---|---| | 1. Collision | elastic head-on bounce reverses $v_x$ | momentum delivered $2mv_x$ | | 2. Round trip | time between hits $2L/v_x$ | force from one molecule $mv_x²/L$ | | 3. Sum over N | average and divide by area | $P = Nm\overline{v_x²}/V$ | | 4.…
